name: kind:intent
description: User problem or feature intent; implementation is optional

name: kind:task
description: Bounded implementation, evaluation, or workflow task

name: stage:triage
description: Awaiting assessment of fit, priority, or missing information

name: stage:ready
description: Scope, baseline, dependencies, and authority checked for assignment

name: stage:implementing
description: An owner is preparing the candidate change

name: stage:review
description: Evaluation, diff review, or integration in progress

name: stage:done
description: Promised delivery endpoint verified with evidence

name: blocked
description: Waiting on a recorded dependency or decision; keep the active stage
